output.answer: Based on Federal Decree-Law No. (35) of 2024 [U1], it is advisable to activate the public alert system to inform residents about potential risks. This aligns with global practices, such as Directive (EU) 2018/1972 [G1], which emphasizes informing end-users about public warning systems. However, UAE sources do not explicitly mention activating the public alert system for every issue, so this decision should be made on a case-by-case basis.
